details.mapped_free: freeBo first refuses unreleasable/mapping leases;for mapped Entry it ignores retireCompleted status but then invokes VM unmap. Poisoned VM unmap returns NotReady before record/table erase or counters change. freeBo returns this error before clearing mapped_state/mapped/iova or releasing memory/clearing Entry. No active Submit Job is required for this refusal.
details.memory: Memory release refuses device refs or quarantine before descriptor/pages/spans changes. releaseSystemInto falls back to release when refs/quarantine present,so this case does not transfer descriptor to deferred-free output. VM detach also rejects poison before freeTables. These source gates retain accounting/backing metadata,not hardware stop/owner/DMA proof.
details.release_all: waitRange validates Submit attachment/poison,then only active queue-domain Jobs;VM-only poison with no accepted Job is not a Submit outstanding Job. It can return0 when range empty,then releaseAll clears each used Entry mapping_leases before freeBo. First failed free aborts loop before queue reset/close. Direct close additionally refuses liveObjects/range/jobs/other queues. No close-success inference from wait0.
details.published: AGX clientClose drops views before g.lock,withdraws mailbox owner then releaseAll. Nonzero prevents forgetVm/destroyVm/live=false and termination call. free deletes core only if not live. Thus original core/space stay on failed teardown,while view withdrawal/mailbox change/lease clearing can already happen. Not an all-or-nothing rollback or universal exclusion contract.
